name: Fam. Banzer
beschreibung: The Banzer Family holiday apartment is located in the quiet district of Kienzen in Tannheim. The surrounding landscape is characterized by the Allgäuer Alpen. Haldensee and Vilsalpsee can be reached by car or bicycle. A direct hiking trail starts at the house. The ski area Neunerköpfle is about three kilometers away. The accommodation has a kitchen with dining area, a living area with satellite TV, and a separate bedroom. From the balcony there is a view of the surrounding peaks, and a garden area with seating is available. Due to its small size and quiet location, the apartment is suitable for couples or small families looking for an uncomplicated holiday in the valley.
